crossRefs.note: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have…

parallels.note: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of…

translations.web: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
translations.bsb: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.
translations.kjv: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
translations.asv: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
